# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Text2Manim DSL 类型定义模块

定义动画描述的标准化数据结构，使用 Pydantic 进行类型验证。
这是整个 Pipeline 的核心数据格式。

DSL 设计原则:
1. 声明式：描述"要什么"，而非"怎么做"
2. 分层：教学大纲 → 动画序列 → 具体动作
3. 可扩展：支持自定义动作类型
4. 可验证：所有字段都有类型约束

Author: Text2Manim Team
Date: 2024-12
"""

from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Literal, Optional, Union
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator


# =============================================================================
# 枚举类型定义
# =============================================================================

class AnimationType(str, Enum):
    """动画类型枚举"""
    # 创建类
    CREATE = "create"
    WRITE = "write"
    FADE_IN = "fade_in"
    FADE_OUT = "fade_out"
    DRAW_BORDER = "draw_border"
    GROW_FROM_CENTER = "grow_from_center"
    
    # 变换类
    TRANSFORM = "transform"
    REPLACEMENT_TRANSFORM = "replacement_transform"
    MORPH = "morph"
    
    # 强调类
    INDICATE = "indicate"
    CIRCUMSCRIBE = "circumscribe"
    FLASH = "flash"
    WIGGLE = "wiggle"
    FOCUS_ON = "focus_on"
    
    # 移动类
    SHIFT = "shift"
    MOVE_TO = "move_to"
    ROTATE = "rotate"
    SCALE = "scale"


class MobjectType(str, Enum):
    """Mobject 对象类型枚举"""
    # 文本类
    TEXT = "text"
    MATH_TEX = "math_tex"
    TEX = "tex"
    PARAGRAPH = "paragraph"
    
    # 几何类
    DOT = "dot"
    LINE = "line"
    ARROW = "arrow"
    DOUBLE_ARROW = "double_arrow"
    CIRCLE = "circle"
    ELLIPSE = "ellipse"
    RECTANGLE = "rectangle"
    SQUARE = "square"
    TRIANGLE = "triangle"
    POLYGON = "polygon"
    ARC = "arc"
    ANGLE = "angle"
    RIGHT_ANGLE = "right_angle"
    
    # 标注类
    BRACE = "brace"
    SURROUNDING_RECTANGLE = "surrounding_rectangle"
    UNDERLINE = "underline"
    CROSS = "cross"
    
    # 坐标系类
    AXES = "axes"
    NUMBER_LINE = "number_line"
    NUMBER_PLANE = "number_plane"
    
    # 图表类
    FUNCTION_GRAPH = "function_graph"
    BAR_CHART = "bar_chart"
    
    # 组合类
    VGROUP = "vgroup"
    
    # 特殊类
    IMAGE = "image"
    SVG = "svg"


class PositionAnchor(str, Enum):
    """位置锚点枚举"""
    CENTER = "center"
    UP = "up"
    DOWN = "down"
    LEFT = "left"
    RIGHT = "right"
    UP_LEFT = "up_left"
    UP_RIGHT = "up_right"
    DOWN_LEFT = "down_left"
    DOWN_RIGHT = "down_right"
    ORIGIN = "origin"


class QualityLevel(str, Enum):
    """渲染质量枚举"""
    LOW = "low"          # 480p, 15fps
    MEDIUM = "medium"    # 720p, 30fps
    HIGH = "high"        # 1080p, 60fps
    FOURK = "fourk"      # 4K, 60fps


# =============================================================================
# 位置和样式相关类型
# =============================================================================

class Position(BaseModel):
    """
    位置描述
    
    支持多种位置表达方式:
    1. 绝对坐标: {"x": 1.0, "y": 2.0}
    2. 相对锚点: {"anchor": "up", "offset": [0, -0.5]}
    3. 相对对象: {"relative_to": "title", "direction": "down", "buff": 0.5}
    """
    # 绝对坐标
    x: Optional[float] = Field(default=None, description="X坐标")
    y: Optional[float] = Field(default=None, description="Y坐标")
    z: Optional[float] = Field(default=0.0, description="Z坐标")
    
    # 锚点定位
    anchor: Optional[PositionAnchor] = Field(default=None, description="锚点位置")
    offset: Optional[List[float]] = Field(default=None, description="偏移量 [x, y]")
    
    # 相对定位
    relative_to: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="相对于哪个对象ID")
    direction: Optional[PositionAnchor] = Field(default=None, description="相对方向")
    buff: Optional[float] = Field(default=0.5, description="间距")
    
    # 边缘对齐
    edge: Optional[PositionAnchor] = Field(default=None, description="对齐到边缘")


class Color(BaseModel):
    """颜色定义"""
    # 可以是预定义颜色名或十六进制
    value: str = Field(default="WHITE", description="颜色值")
    opacity: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="透明度")


class Style(BaseModel):
    """样式定义"""
    color: Optional[Color] = Field(default=None, description="颜色")
    fill_color: Optional[Color] = Field(default=None, description="填充色")
    stroke_color: Optional[Color] = Field(default=None, description="描边色")
    stroke_width: Optional[float] = Field(default=None, description="描边宽度")
    font_size: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, description="字体大小")
    fill_opacity: Optional[float] = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="填充透明度")


# =============================================================================
# Mobject 定义
# =============================================================================

class MobjectBase(BaseModel):
    """Mobject 基类"""
    id: str = Field(..., description="对象唯一标识符")
    type: MobjectType = Field(..., description="对象类型")
    position: Optional[Position] = Field(default=None, description="位置")
    style: Optional[Style] = Field(default=None, description="样式")


class TextMobject(MobjectBase):
    """文本对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.TEXT] = MobjectType.TEXT
    content: str = Field(..., description="文本内容")
    font: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="字体")


class MathTexMobject(MobjectBase):
    """数学公式对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.MATH_TEX] = MobjectType.MATH_TEX
    latex: str = Field(..., description="LaTeX公式")
    substrings_to_isolate: Optional[List[str]] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="需要单独处理的子字符串"
    )


class DotMobject(MobjectBase):
    """点对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.DOT] = MobjectType.DOT
    radius: float = Field(default=0.08, description="半径")


class LineMobject(MobjectBase):
    """线段对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.LINE] = MobjectType.LINE
    start: List[float] = Field(..., description="起点坐标 [x, y]")
    end: List[float] = Field(..., description="终点坐标 [x, y]")


class ArrowMobject(MobjectBase):
    """箭头对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.ARROW] = MobjectType.ARROW
    start: List[float] = Field(..., description="起点坐标 [x, y]")
    end: List[float] = Field(..., description="终点坐标 [x, y]")
    tip_length: Optional[float] = Field(default=0.25, description="箭头长度")


class CircleMobject(MobjectBase):
    """圆形对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.CIRCLE] = MobjectType.CIRCLE

class RectangleMobject(MobjectBase):
    """矩形对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.RECTANGLE] = MobjectType.RECTANGLE

class SquareMobject(MobjectBase):

    type: Literal[MobjectType.SQUARE] = MobjectType.SQUARE
    side_length: float = Field(default=1.0, description="边长")


class PolygonMobject(MobjectBase):
    """多边形对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.POLYGON] = MobjectType.POLYGON
    vertices: List[List[float]] = Field(..., description="顶点列表 [[x1,y1], [x2,y2], ...]")


class TriangleMobject(MobjectBase):
    """三角形对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.TRIANGLE] = MobjectType.TRIANGLE
    vertices: Optional[List[List[float]]] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="顶点列表，如果不指定则使用默认等边三角形"
    )


class RightAngleMobject(MobjectBase):
    """直角标记对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.RIGHT_ANGLE] = MobjectType.RIGHT_ANGLE
    vertex: List[float] = Field(..., description="直角顶点")
    line1_point: List[float] = Field(..., description="第一条边上的点")
    line2_point: List[float] = Field(..., description="第二条边上的点")
    size: float = Field(default=0.25, description="直角标记大小")


class BraceMobject(MobjectBase):
    """大括号标注对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.BRACE] = MobjectType.BRACE
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="目标对象ID")
    direction: PositionAnchor = Field(default=PositionAnchor.DOWN, description="括号方向")
    text: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="括号上的文字")


class SurroundingRectangleMobject(MobjectBase):
    """包围矩形对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.SURROUNDING_RECTANGLE] = MobjectType.SURROUNDING_RECTANGLE
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="目标对象ID")
    buff: float = Field(default=0.15, description="边距")
    corner_radius: float = Field(default=0.0, description="圆角半径")


class AxesMobject(MobjectBase):
    """坐标轴对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.AXES] = MobjectType.AXES
    x_range: List[float] = Field(default=[-5, 5, 1], description="X轴范围 [min, max, step]")
    y_range: List[float] = Field(default=[-3, 3, 1], description="Y轴范围 [min, max, step]")
    x_length: float = Field(default=10, description="X轴长度")
    y_length: float = Field(default=6, description="Y轴长度")
    axis_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(default=None, description="轴配置")


class FunctionGraphMobject(MobjectBase):
    """函数图像对象"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.FUNCTION_GRAPH] = MobjectType.FUNCTION_GRAPH
    function_expr: str = Field(..., description="函数表达式，如 'lambda x: x**2'")
    x_range: List[float] = Field(default=[-5, 5], description="X范围 [min, max]")
    axes_id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="关联的坐标轴ID")


class VGroupMobject(MobjectBase):
    """对象组"""
    type: Literal[MobjectType.VGROUP] = MobjectType.VGROUP
    children_ids: List[str] = Field(..., description="子对象ID列表")
    arrangement: Optional[Literal["horizontal", "vertical", "none"]] = Field(
        default="none",
        description="排列方式"
    )
    buff: float = Field(default=0.5, description="间距")


# 联合类型：所有 Mobject
MobjectDefinition = Union[
    TextMobject,
    MathTexMobject,
    DotMobject,
    LineMobject,
    ArrowMobject,
    CircleMobject,
    RectangleMobject,
    SquareMobject,
    PolygonMobject,
    TriangleMobject,
    RightAngleMobject,
    BraceMobject,
    SurroundingRectangleMobject,
    AxesMobject,
    FunctionGraphMobject,
    VGroupMobject
]


# =============================================================================
# 动画动作定义
# =============================================================================

class ActionBase(BaseModel):
    """动作基类"""
    type: str = Field(..., description="动作类型")
    target_id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="目标对象ID")
    run_time: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.1, description="动画时长")


class CreateAction(ActionBase):
    """创建动作"""
    type: Literal["create"] = "create"
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="要创建的对象ID")
    animation: AnimationType = Field(
        default=AnimationType.CREATE, 
        description="创建动画类型"
    )
    # FadeIn 特定参数
    shift_direction: Optional[PositionAnchor] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="FadeIn时的移动方向"
    )


class TransformAction(ActionBase):
    """变换动作"""
    type: Literal["transform"] = "transform"
    source_id: str = Field(..., description="源对象ID")
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="目标对象ID")
    animation: Literal["transform", "replacement_transform", "morph"] = Field(
        default="transform",
        description="变换类型"
    )


class IndicateAction(ActionBase):
    """强调动作"""
    type: Literal["indicate"] = "indicate"
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="要强调的对象ID")
    animation: Literal["indicate", "circumscribe", "flash", "wiggle", "focus_on"] = Field(
        default="indicate",
        description="强调动画类型"
    )
    scale_factor: float = Field(default=1.2, description="缩放比例(indicate)")
    color: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="强调颜色")


class MoveAction(ActionBase):
    """移动动作"""
    type: Literal["move"] = "move"
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="要移动的对象ID")
    to_position: Optional[Position] = Field(default=None, description="目标位置")
    shift: Optional[List[float]] = Field(default=None, description="相对移动 [dx, dy]")


class RotateAction(ActionBase):
    """旋转动作"""
    type: Literal["rotate"] = "rotate"
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="要旋转的对象ID")
    angle: float = Field(..., description="旋转角度(弧度)")
    about_point: Optional[List[float]] = Field(default=None, description="旋转中心")


class ScaleAction(ActionBase):
    """缩放动作"""
    type: Literal["scale"] = "scale"
    target_id: str = Field(..., description="要缩放的对象ID")
    scale_factor: float = Field(..., description="缩放比例")
    about_point: Optional[List[float]] = Field(default=None, description="缩放中心")


class FadeOutAction(ActionBase):
    """淡出动作"""
    type: Literal["fade_out"] = "fade_out"
    target_ids: List[str] = Field(..., description="要淡出的对象ID列表")
    shift_direction: Optional[PositionAnchor] = Field(default=None, description="移动方向")


class WaitAction(ActionBase):
    """等待动作"""
    type: Literal["wait"] = "wait"
    duration: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.0, description="等待时长")


class GroupAction(ActionBase):
    """组合动作（同时执行多个动画）"""
    type: Literal["group"] = "group"
    actions: List["ActionDefinition"] = Field(..., description="同时执行的动作列表")


class SequenceAction(ActionBase):
    """序列动作（依次执行，带延迟）"""
    type: Literal["sequence"] = "sequence"
    actions: List["ActionDefinition"] = Field(..., description="依次执行的动作列表")
    lag_ratio: float = Field(default=0.2, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="延迟比例")


# 联合类型：所有动作
ActionDefinition = Union[
    CreateAction,
    TransformAction,
    IndicateAction,
    MoveAction,
    RotateAction,
    ScaleAction,
    FadeOutAction,
    WaitAction,
    GroupAction,
    SequenceAction
]

# 更新前向引用
GroupAction.model_rebuild()
SequenceAction.model_rebuild()


# =============================================================================
# 场景和序列定义
# =============================================================================

class Sequence(BaseModel):
    """
    动画序列
    
    一个序列对应一个教学步骤/镜头，包含:
    1. 该步骤需要创建的对象
    2. 该步骤要执行的动画动作
    """
    id: str = Field(..., description="序列唯一标识符")
    name: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="序列名称（注释用）")
    narration: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="旁白/解说词")
    
    # 对象定义：该序列中新创建的对象
    mobjects: List[MobjectDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="该序列中定义的对象"
    )
    
    # 动作列表
    actions: List[ActionDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="动画动作序列"
    )


class AnimationScript(BaseModel):
    """
    完整的动画脚本
    
    这是 DSL 的顶层结构，包含:
    1. 元信息（场景名、质量设置等）
    2. 全局对象定义
    3. 动画序列列表
    """
    # 元信息
    scene_name: str = Field(default="MainScene", description="场景类名")
    title: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="动画标题")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="动画描述")
    
    # 渲染设置
    quality: QualityLevel = Field(default=QualityLevel.MEDIUM, description="渲染质量")
    background_color: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="背景色")
    
    # 全局对象（在所有序列之前创建）
    global_mobjects: List[MobjectDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="全局对象定义"
    )
    
    # 序列列表
    sequences: List[Sequence] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="动画序列列表"
    )
    
    @field_validator("sequences")
    @classmethod
    def validate_sequences_not_empty(cls, v):
        if not v:
            raise ValueError("动画脚本至少需要一个序列")
        return v


# =============================================================================
# 教学大纲（Layer 1 输出）
# =============================================================================

class TeachingStepType(str, Enum):
    """教学步骤类型"""
    TITLE = "title"                  # 标题页
    INTRODUCTION = "introduction"    # 引入
    DEFINITION = "definition"        # 定义
    EXAMPLE = "example"              # 示例
    CONSTRUCTION = "construction"    # 构造/作图
    DERIVATION = "derivation"        # 推导
    PROOF = "proof"                  # 证明
    HIGHLIGHT = "highlight"          # 重点强调
    SUMMARY = "summary"              # 总结
    EXERCISE = "exercise"            # 练习


class TeachingStep(BaseModel):
    """教学步骤"""
    type: TeachingStepType = Field(..., description="步骤类型")
    title: str = Field(..., description="步骤标题")
    content: str = Field(..., description="内容描述")
    duration_hint: float = Field(default=3.0, description="建议时长(秒)")
    visual_elements: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="视觉元素描述"
    )
    key_points: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="关键点"
    )


class TeachingOutline(BaseModel):
    """
    教学大纲
    
    Layer 1 的输出，描述教学内容的结构化组织
    """
    topic: str = Field(..., description="主题")
    subject_area: str = Field(..., description="学科领域")
    difficulty_level: Literal["elementary", "middle", "high", "college"] = Field(
        default="high",
        description="难度级别"
    )
    
    # 前置知识
    prerequisites: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="前置知识要求"
    )
    
    # 学习目标
    learning_objectives: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="学习目标"
    )
    
    # 教学步骤
    steps: List[TeachingStep] = Field(..., description="教学步骤序列")
    
    # 总时长估计
    estimated_duration: float = Field(default=30.0, description="估计总时长(秒)")


# =============================================================================
# Pipeline 状态定义（用于 LangGraph）
# =============================================================================

class PipelineState(BaseModel):
    """
    Pipeline 执行状态
    
    用于 LangGraph 的状态管理，跟踪整个生成流程
    """
    # 输入
    user_input: str = Field(..., description="用户原始输入")
    
    # 中间结果
    teaching_outline: Optional[TeachingOutline] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="教学大纲"
    )
    animation_script: Optional[AnimationScript] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="动画脚本DSL"
    )
    manim_code: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="生成的Manim代码"
    )
    
    # 执行状态
    current_step: str = Field(default="init", description="当前步骤")
    error_message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="错误信息")
    retry_count: int = Field(default=0, description="重试次数")
    
    # 输出
    output_file: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="输出视频路径")
    success: bool = Field(default=False, description="是否成功")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 测试 DSL 结构
    from loguru import logger
    
    # 创建示例脚本
    script = AnimationScript(
        scene_name="PythagoreanTheorem",
        title="勾股定理证明",
        sequences=[
            Sequence(
                id="intro",
                name="标题引入",
                mobjects=[
                    TextMobject(
                        id="title",
                        content="勾股定理",
                        position=Position(edge=PositionAnchor.UP)
                    )
                ],
                actions=[
                    CreateAction(target_id="title", animation=AnimationType.WRITE),
                    WaitAction(duration=1.0)
                ]
            )
        ]
    )
    
    logger.info(f"DSL 验证通过: {script.scene_name}")
    logger.info(f"JSON:\n{script.model_dump_json(indent=2)}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Text2Manim Planner Prompts 模块

Layer 1: 教学内容理解与规划
将用户输入转换为结构化的教学大纲。

使用 Chain-of-Thought (COT) 提示技术，确保:
1. 深入理解教学内容
2. 合理划分教学步骤
3. 输出结构化 JSON

Author: Text2Manim Team
Date: 2024-12
"""

from typing import Dict, Any

# =============================================================================
# 系统提示词
# =============================================================================

PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """你是一位专业的数学教育内容规划专家。你的任务是将用户描述的数学主题转换为结构化的教学大纲。

## 你的专业能力

1. **深度理解数学概念**: 能够准确理解各类数学概念、定理、公式的本质
2. **教学设计经验**: 熟悉从引入到总结的完整教学流程设计
3. **视觉化思维**: 能够为抽象数学概念设计直观的视觉呈现方案
4. **循序渐进**: 善于将复杂内容分解为易于理解的步骤

## 教学步骤类型

你可以使用以下类型的教学步骤:

def build_planner_prompt(user_input: str, include_examples: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    构建 Planner 的完整提示词
    
    Args:
        user_input: 用户输入的主题描述
        include_examples: 是否包含 few-shot 示例
        
    Returns:
        消息列表，可直接用于 OpenAI API
    """
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT}
    ]
    
    # 添加 few-shot 示例
    if include_examples:
        for example in PLANNER_EXAMPLES:
            # 用户示例
            messages.append({
                "role": "user",
                "content": PLANNER_USER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(user_input=example["input"])
            })
            # 助手回复
            import json
            messages.append({
                "role": "assistant",
                "content": json.dumps(example["output"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            })
    
    # 添加实际用户输入
    messages.append({
        "role": "user",
        "content": PLANNER_USER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(user_input=user_input)
    })
    
    return messages

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Text2Manim LLM Client 模块

封装 OpenAI API 调用，提供统一的 LLM 交互接口。

特性:
1. 支持自定义 base_url（兼容本地模型服务）
2. 自动重试机制
3. 完整的错误处理和日志记录
4. 支持流式输出

Author: Text2Manim Team
Date: 2024-12
"""

import sys
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, Generator, List, Optional, Union

from loguru import logger
from openai import OpenAI, APIError, APIConnectionError, RateLimitError, APITimeoutError

from ..config import LLMConfig, get_config


class LLMClientError(Exception):
    """LLM 客户端错误基类"""
    pass


class LLMAPIError(LLMClientError):
    """API 调用错误"""
    pass


class LLMResponseError(LLMClientError):
    """响应解析错误"""
    pass


class LLMClient:
    """
    LLM 客户端
    
    封装 OpenAI API，提供:
    1. 统一的调用接口
    2. 自动重试机制
    3. 日志记录
    4. 错误处理
    
    使用示例:
    ```python
    client = LLMClient()
    response = client.chat([
        {"role": "user", "content": "你好"}
    ])
    print(response)
    ```
    """
    
    def __init__(self, config: Optional[LLMConfig] = None):
        """
        初始化 LLM 客户端
        
        Args:
            config: LLM配置，如果不提供则使用全局配置
        """
        self.config = config or get_config().llm
        
        # 初始化 OpenAI 客户端
        self._client = OpenAI(
            api_key=self.config.openai_api_key,
            base_url=self.config.openai_base_url,
            timeout=self.config.timeout,
            max_retries=0  # 我们自己处理重试
        )
        
        logger.info(
            f"LLM 客户端初始化完成 | "
            f"模型: {self.config.openai_model} | "
            f"API: {self.config.openai_base_url}"
        )
    
    def chat(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, str]],
        temperature: Optional[float] = None,
        max_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
        stop: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> str:
        """
        发送聊天请求并获取响应
        
        Args:
            messages: 消息列表
            temperature: 温度参数（可选，覆盖默认值）
            max_tokens: 最大token数（可选，覆盖默认值）
            stop: 停止序列
            **kwargs: 其他传递给 API 的参数
            
        Returns:
            模型生成的文本响应
            
        Raises:
            LLMAPIError: API 调用失败
            LLMResponseError: 响应解析失败
        """
        temperature = temperature if temperature is not None else self.config.temperature
        max_tokens = max_tokens if max_tokens is not None else self.config.max_tokens
        
        logger.debug(
            f"发送请求 | 消息数: {len(messages)} | "
            f"温度: {temperature} | 最大token: {max_tokens}"
        )
        
        # 重试逻辑
        last_error: Optional[Exception] = None
        for attempt in range(self.config.max_retries + 1):
            try:
                response = self._client.chat.completions.create(
                    model=self.config.openai_model,
                    messages=messages,
                    temperature=temperature,
                    max_tokens=max_tokens,
                    stop=stop,
                    **kwargs
                )
                
                # 提取响应内容
                if not response.choices:
                    raise LLMResponseError("API 返回空的 choices 列表")
                
                content = response.choices[0].message.content
                if content is None:
                    raise LLMResponseError("API 返回空的 content")
                
                # 记录使用情况
                if response.usage:
                    logger.debug(
                        f"请求完成 | "
                        f"输入token: {response.usage.prompt_tokens} | "
                        f"输出token: {response.usage.completion_tokens}"
                    )
                
                return content
                
            except (APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError) as e:
                last_error = e
                logger.warning(
                    f"API 连接错误 (尝试 {attempt + 1}/{self.config.max_retries + 1}): {e}"
                )
                if attempt < self.config.max_retries:
                    wait_time = 2 ** attempt  # 指数退避
                    logger.info(f"等待 {wait_time} 秒后重试...")
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    
            except RateLimitError as e:
                last_error = e
                logger.warning(f"触发速率限制: {e}")
                if attempt < self.config.max_retries:
                    wait_time = 30  # 速率限制等待更长
                    logger.info(f"等待 {wait_time} 秒后重试...")
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    
            except APIError as e:
                # 其他 API 错误不重试
                logger.exception(f"API 错误: {e}")
                raise LLMAPIError(f"API 调用失败: {e}") from e
                
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(f"未知错误: {e}")
                raise LLMClientError(f"LLM 调用失败: {e}") from e
        
        # 所有重试都失败
        logger.error(f"API 调用失败，已重试 {self.config.max_retries} 次")
        raise LLMAPIError(f"API 调用失败: {last_error}")
    
    def chat_stream(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, str]],
        temperature: Optional[float] = None,
        max_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> Generator[str, None, None]:
        """
        发送聊天请求并获取流式响应
        
        Args:
            messages: 消息列表
            temperature: 温度参数
            max_tokens: 最大token数
            **kwargs: 其他参数
            
        Yields:
            逐个生成的文本片段
        """
        temperature = temperature if temperature is not None else self.config.temperature
        max_tokens = max_tokens if max_tokens is not None else self.config.max_tokens
        
        try:
            response = self._client.chat.completions.create(
                model=self.config.openai_model,
                messages=messages,
                temperature=temperature,
                max_tokens=max_tokens,
                stream=True,
                **kwargs
            )
            
            for chunk in response:
                if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
                    yield chunk.choices[0].delta.content
                    
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"流式请求失败: {e}")
            raise LLMAPIError(f"流式请求失败: {e}") from e


# =============================================================================
# 便捷函数
# =============================================================================

_default_client: Optional[LLMClient] = None


def get_llm_client() -> LLMClient:
    """
    获取默认的 LLM 客户端（单例模式）
    
    Returns:
        LLMClient 实例
    """
    global _default_client
    if _default_client is None:
        _default_client = LLMClient()
    return _default_client


def chat(
    messages: List[Dict[str, str]],
    **kwargs
) -> str:
    """
    便捷的聊天函数
    
    Args:
        messages: 消息列表
        **kwargs: 传递给 LLMClient.chat 的参数
        
    Returns:
        模型响应
    """
    return get_llm_client().chat(messages, **kwargs)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 测试 LLM 客户端
    from ..config import init_config
    
    # 初始化配置
    config = init_config()
    config.llm.openai_model = "gpt-3.5-turbo"  # 测试用
    
    # 创建客户端
    client = LLMClient(config.llm)
    
    # 测试请求
    try:
        response = client.chat([
            {"role": "system", "content": "你是一个数学助手。"},
            {"role": "user", "content": "1+1等于多少？简短回答。"}
        ])
        logger.info(f"响应: {response}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"测试失败: {e}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Text2Manim JSON 解析器模块

提供从 LLM 响应中提取和解析 JSON 的功能。

特性:
1. 支持多种 JSON 包裹格式（```json, ```等）
2. 智能修复常见 JSON 格式错误
3. 完整的错误处理和日志记录
4. 支持嵌套 JSON 提取

Author: Text2Manim Team
Date: 2024-12
"""

import json
import re
import sys
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from loguru import logger


class JSONParseError(Exception):
    """JSON 解析错误"""
    
    def __init__(self, message: str, raw_text: Optional[str] = None):
        self.message = message
        self.raw_text = raw_text
        super().__init__(message)


class JSONExtractor:
    """
    JSON 提取器
    
    从各种格式的文本中提取 JSON 内容，支持:
    1. Markdown 代码块格式 (```json ... ```)
    2. 纯 JSON 文本
    3. 带有其他文本的混合内容
    """
    
    # 用于匹配 JSON 代码块的正则表达式
    # 匹配 ```json 或 ``` 开头的代码块
    JSON_BLOCK_PATTERN = re.compile(
        r'```(?:json)?\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)\n?```',
        re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE
    )
    
    # 匹配裸露的 JSON 对象
    JSON_OBJECT_PATTERN = re.compile(
        r'\{[\s\S]*\}',
        re.MULTILINE
    )
    
    # 匹配裸露的 JSON 数组
    JSON_ARRAY_PATTERN = re.compile(
        r'\[[\s\S]*\]',
        re.MULTILINE
    )
    
    @classmethod
    def extract_json_string(cls, text: str) -> str:
        """
        从文本中提取 JSON 字符串
        
        按优先级尝试以下方法:
        1. 提取 Markdown 代码块中的内容
        2. 提取裸露的 JSON 对象
        3. 提取裸露的 JSON 数组
        
        Args:
            text: 原始文本
            
        Returns:
            提取出的 JSON 字符串
            
        Raises:
            JSONParseError: 无法提取 JSON
        """
        if not text or not text.strip():
            raise JSONParseError("输入文本为空", text)
        
        text = text.strip()
        
        # 方法1: 尝试从代码块中提取
        matches = cls.JSON_BLOCK_PATTERN.findall(text)
        if matches:
            # 取第一个匹配的代码块
            json_str = matches[0].strip()
            logger.debug(f"从代码块中提取到 JSON ({len(json_str)} 字符)")
            return json_str
        
        # 方法2: 尝试提取裸露的 JSON 对象
        obj_match = cls.JSON_OBJECT_PATTERN.search(text)
        if obj_match:
            json_str = obj_match.group(0).strip()
            logger.debug(f"提取到 JSON 对象 ({len(json_str)} 字符)")
            return json_str
        
        # 方法3: 尝试提取裸露的 JSON 数组
        arr_match = cls.JSON_ARRAY_PATTERN.search(text)
        if arr_match:
            json_str = arr_match.group(0).strip()
            logger.debug(f"提取到 JSON 数组 ({len(json_str)} 字符)")
            return json_str
        
        # 方法4: 假设整个文本就是 JSON
        if text.startswith('{') or text.startswith('['):
            logger.debug("假设整个文本为 JSON")
            return text
        
        raise JSONParseError("无法从文本中提取 JSON 内容", text)
    
    @classmethod
    def fix_common_errors(cls, json_str: str) -> str:
        """
        修复常见的 JSON 格式错误
        
        处理:
        1. 尾随逗号
        2. 单引号 -> 双引号
        3. 未转义的换行符
        4. 注释
        5. 缺少引号的键
        
        Args:
            json_str: 原始 JSON 字符串
            
        Returns:
            修复后的 JSON 字符串
        """
        original = json_str
        
        # 1. 移除 JavaScript 风格的注释
        # 移除 // 注释
        json_str = re.sub(r'//[^\n]*', '', json_str)
        # 移除 /* */ 注释
        json_str = re.sub(r'/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', '', json_str)
        
        # 2. 移除尾随逗号（对象和数组中）
        # ,} -> }
        json_str = re.sub(r',\s*}', '}', json_str)
        # ,] -> ]
        json_str = re.sub(r',\s*]', ']', json_str)
        
        # 3. 处理单引号（简单情况）
        # 注意：这是一个简化处理，可能在某些边界情况下不准确
        # 只处理明显是键值对的单引号
        # 'key': -> "key":
        json_str = re.sub(r"'([^']+)'(\s*:)", r'"\1"\2', json_str)
        # : 'value' -> : "value"
        json_str = re.sub(r"(:\s*)'([^']*)'(\s*[,}\]])", r'\1"\2"\3', json_str)
        
        # 4. 修复未加引号的键（简单情况）
        # { key: -> { "key":
        json_str = re.sub(r'{\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*:', r'{ "\1":', json_str)
        # , key: -> , "key":
        json_str = re.sub(r',\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*:', r', "\1":', json_str)
        
        # 5. 修复布尔值和 null（大小写）
        json_str = re.sub(r'\bTrue\b', 'true', json_str)
        json_str = re.sub(r'\bFalse\b', 'false', json_str)
        json_str = re.sub(r'\bNone\b', 'null', json_str)
        
        if json_str != original:
            logger.debug("已修复 JSON 格式错误")
        
        return json_str


def extract_json(text: str, fix_errors: bool = True) -> str:
    """
    从文本中提取 JSON 字符串
    
    Args:
        text: 原始文本
        fix_errors: 是否尝试修复常见错误
        
    Returns:
        提取出的 JSON 字符串
    """
    json_str = JSONExtractor.extract_json_string(text)
    
    if fix_errors:
        json_str = JSONExtractor.fix_common_errors(json_str)
    
    return json_str


def parse_json(
    text: str, 
    fix_errors: bool = True,
    strict: bool = False
) -> Union[Dict[str, Any], List[Any]]:
    """
    从文本中提取并解析 JSON
    
    Args:
        text: 原始文本（可能包含代码块或其他内容）
        fix_errors: 是否尝试修复常见错误
        strict: 是否使用严格模式（不允许尾随逗号等）
        
    Returns:
        解析后的 Python 对象（字典或列表）
        
    Raises:
        JSONParseError: 解析失败
    """
    try:
        # 提取 JSON 字符串
        json_str = extract_json(text, fix_errors=fix_errors)
        
        # 解析 JSON
        try:
            result = json.loads(json_str, strict=strict)
            logger.debug(f"JSON 解析成功，类型: {type(result).__name__}")
            return result
            
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            # 尝试更激进的修复
            if fix_errors and not strict:
                logger.warning(f"JSON 解析失败，尝试更多修复: {e}")
                
                # 尝试找到有效的 JSON 子串
                result = _find_valid_json_substring(json_str)
                if result is not None:
                    return result
            
            raise JSONParseError(
                f"JSON 解析错误: {e.msg} (行 {e.lineno}, 列 {e.colno})",
                json_str
            )
            
    except JSONParseError:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"JSON 处理失败: {e}")
        raise JSONParseError(f"JSON 处理失败: {e}", text)


def _find_valid_json_substring(text: str) -> Optional[Union[Dict, List]]:
    """
    尝试在文本中找到有效的 JSON 子串
    
    使用启发式方法，从第一个 { 或 [ 开始，
    逐步扩展直到找到有效的 JSON
    """
    # 找到开始位置
    obj_start = text.find('{')
    arr_start = text.find('[')
    
    if obj_start == -1 and arr_start == -1:
        return None
    
    # 确定开始位置和对应的结束字符
    if obj_start != -1 and (arr_start == -1 or obj_start < arr_start):
        start = obj_start
        end_char = '}'
    else:
        start = arr_start
        end_char = ']'
    
    # 从后往前找对应的结束符
    for end in range(len(text) - 1, start, -1):
        if text[end] == end_char:
            substring = text[start:end + 1]
            try:
                return json.loads(substring)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
    
    return None


def safe_parse_json(
    text: str,
    default: Optional[Any] = None,
    fix_errors: bool = True
) -> Tuple[Optional[Union[Dict, List]], Optional[str]]:
    """
    安全地解析 JSON，失败时返回默认值
    
    Args:
        text: 原始文本
        default: 解析失败时的默认值
        fix_errors: 是否尝试修复错误
        
    Returns:
        (解析结果, 错误信息)
        如果成功，错误信息为 None
        如果失败，解析结果为 default
    """
    try:
        result = parse_json(text, fix_errors=fix_errors)
        return result, None
    except JSONParseError as e:
        logger.warning(f"JSON 解析失败: {e.message}")
        return default, e.message
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"JSON 解析异常: {e}")
        return default, str(e)


def extract_code_block(text: str, language: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """
    从文本中提取代码块
    
    Args:
        text: 原始文本
        language: 指定的语言（如 "python"），None 表示任意语言
        
    Returns:
        提取出的代码内容
        
    Raises:
        ValueError: 未找到代码块
    """
    if language:
        # 匹配特定语言的代码块
        pattern = re.compile(
            rf'```{language}\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```',
            re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE
        )
    else:
        # 匹配任意代码块
        pattern = re.compile(
            r'```(?:\w+)?\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```',
            re.MULTILINE
        )
    
    matches = pattern.findall(text)
    if not matches:
        # 尝试不带换行的格式
        pattern2 = re.compile(
            r'```(?:\w+)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```',
            re.MULTILINE
        )
        matches = pattern2.findall(text)
    
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError(f"未找到代码块 (语言: {language or '任意'})")
    
    return matches[0].strip()


def extract_python_code(text: str) -> str:
    """
    从文本中提取 Python 代码
    
    Args:
        text: 原始文本
        
    Returns:
        提取出的 Python 代码
        
    Raises:
        ValueError: 未找到 Python 代码
    """
    try:
        return extract_code_block(text, "python")
    except ValueError:
        # 尝试匹配任意代码块
        try:
            return extract_code_block(text, None)
        except ValueError:
            # 如果没有代码块，检查是否整个文本就是代码
            if "from manim import" in text or "class " in text:
                return text.strip()
            raise ValueError("未找到 Python 代码")


if __name__ == "__main__":

    # 测试1: Markdown 代码块

    ```json
    }
    ```
    
    这是更多说明
    '''
    
    result1 = parse_json(test1)
    print(f"测试1 (Markdown 代码块): {result1}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Text2Manim Pipeline State 模块

定义 LangGraph Pipeline 的状态管理。

Author: Text2Manim Team
Date: 2024-12
"""

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, TypedDict, Annotated
from operator import add

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class PipelineState(TypedDict, total=False):
    """
    Pipeline 状态定义
    
    使用 TypedDict 以兼容 LangGraph 的状态管理。
    所有字段都是可选的，允许增量更新。
    """
    # 输入
    user_input: str
    
    # Layer 1 输出: 教学大纲
    teaching_outline: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    
    # Layer 2 输出: 动画 DSL
    animation_script: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    
    # Layer 3 输出: Manim 代码
    manim_code: Optional[str]
    
    # 执行状态
    current_step: str
    step_history: Annotated[List[str], add]  # 使用 Annotated 实现列表追加
    
    # 错误处理
    error_message: Optional[str]
    retry_count: int
    
    # 输出
    output_file: Optional[str]
    success: bool
    
    # 调试信息
    debug_info: Dict[str, Any]


class PipelineResult(BaseModel):
    """
    Pipeline 执行结果
    
    用于返回给调用者的最终结果。
    """
    success: bool = Field(default=False, description="是否成功")
    
    # 各层输出
    teaching_outline: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="教学大纲"
    )
    animation_script: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="动画DSL脚本"
    )
    manim_code: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="Manim代码"
    )
    
    # 执行信息
    output_file: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="输出视频文件路径"
    )
    error_message: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="错误信息"
    )
    
    # 执行统计
    steps_executed: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, 
        description="已执行的步骤"
    )
    total_time: float = Field(
        default=0.0, 
        description="总执行时间(秒)"
    )


def create_initial_state(user_input: str) -> PipelineState:
    """
    创建初始状态
    
    Args:
        user_input: 用户输入
        
    Returns:
        初始化的状态字典
    """
    return PipelineState(
        user_input=user_input,
        teaching_outline=None,
        animation_script=None,
        manim_code=None,
        current_step="init",
        step_history=["init"],
        error_message=None,
        retry_count=0,
        output_file=None,
        success=False,
        debug_info={}
    )


def update_state(
    state: PipelineState, 
    **updates
) -> PipelineState:
    """
    更新状态
    
    Args:
        state: 当前状态
        **updates: 要更新的字段
        
    Returns:
        更新后的状态（新字典，不修改原状态）
    """
    new_state = dict(state)
    new_state.update(updates)
    return PipelineState(**new_state)


def state_to_result(state: PipelineState, total_time: float = 0.0) -> PipelineResult:
    """
    将状态转换为结果对象
    
    Args:
        state: 最终状态
        total_time: 总执行时间
        
    Returns:
        PipelineResult 对象
    """
    return PipelineResult(
        success=state.get("success", False),
        teaching_outline=state.get("teaching_outline"),
        animation_script=state.get("animation_script"),
        manim_code=state.get("manim_code"),
        output_file=state.get("output_file"),
        error_message=state.get("error_message"),
        steps_executed=state.get("step_history", []),
        total_time=total_time
    )

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
text2manim.pipeline.nodes - LangGraph流水线节点

实现各个处理阶段的节点函数:
- planner_node: 教学大纲规划
- animator_node: DSL动画脚本设计  
- coder_node: Manim代码生成
- code_fixer_node: 代码修复
- executor_node: 代码执行与渲染

每个节点遵循LangGraph规范，接收state并返回更新后的state片段。
"""

import time
from typing import Dict, Any, Literal
from loguru import logger

from text2manim.pipeline.state import PipelineState
from text2manim.llm.client import get_llm_client, LLMClientError
from text2manim.prompts import (
    build_planner_prompt,
    build_animator_prompt,
    build_coder_prompt,
    build_code_fix_prompt,
)
from text2manim.utils.json_parser import parse_json, extract_python_code
from text2manim.schema import (
    TeachingOutline,
    AnimationScript,
    DSLValidator,
)
from text2manim.config import get_config


# =============================================================================
# Planner Node - 教学大纲规划
# =============================================================================

def planner_node(state: PipelineState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    教学大纲规划节点
    
    将用户输入转换为结构化的教学大纲(TeachingOutline)。
    
    输入:
        state.user_input: 用户的自然语言输入
        
    输出:
        state.teaching_outline: TeachingOutline对象
        state.current_step: 更新为 "animator"
        state.step_history: 添加 "planner"
        
    Raises:
        异常被捕获并记录到state.error_message
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始执行 Planner 节点")
    logger.info("="*60)
    
    user_input = state["user_input"]
    logger.info(f"用户输入: {user_input[:100]}..." if len(user_input) > 100 else f"用户输入: {user_input}")
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # 构建prompt并调用LLM
        messages = build_planner_prompt(user_input)
        logger.debug(f"Planner prompt消息数: {len(messages)}")
        
        client = get_llm_client()
        response = client.chat(messages)
        
        logger.debug(f"LLM响应长度: {len(response)}")
        
        # 解析JSON响应
        outline_dict = parse_json(response)
        if outline_dict is None:
            raise ValueError("无法从LLM响应中解析JSON")
        
        # 验证并创建TeachingOutline对象
        teaching_outline = TeachingOutline(**outline_dict)
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.success(f"Planner节点完成，耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
        logger.info(f"教学主题: {teaching_outline.topic}")
        logger.info(f"教学步骤数: {len(teaching_outline.steps)}")
        
        # 保存调试信息
        debug_info = state.get("debug_info", {})
        debug_info["planner_response"] = response
        debug_info["planner_elapsed"] = elapsed
        
        return {
            "teaching_outline": teaching_outline,
            "current_step": "animator",
            "step_history": ["planner"],
            "debug_info": debug_info,
        }
        
    except LLMClientError as e:
        logger.error(f"LLM调用失败: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"LLM调用失败: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["planner_failed"],
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Planner节点异常: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"Planner节点异常: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["planner_failed"],
        }


# =============================================================================
# Animator Node - DSL动画脚本设计
# =============================================================================

def animator_node(state: PipelineState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    DSL动画脚本设计节点
    
    将教学大纲转换为DSL格式的动画脚本(AnimationScript)。
    
    输入:
        state.teaching_outline: TeachingOutline对象
        
    输出:
        state.animation_script: AnimationScript对象
        state.current_step: 更新为 "coder"
        state.step_history: 添加 "animator"
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始执行 Animator 节点")
    logger.info("="*60)
    
    teaching_outline = state.get("teaching_outline")
    if teaching_outline is None:
        logger.error("teaching_outline为空，无法继续")
        return {
            "error_message": "教学大纲为空，请先运行Planner节点",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["animator_failed"],
        }
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # 构建prompt并调用LLM
        messages = build_animator_prompt(teaching_outline)
        logger.debug(f"Animator prompt消息数: {len(messages)}")
        
        client = get_llm_client()
        response = client.chat(messages)
        
        logger.debug(f"LLM响应长度: {len(response)}")
        
        # 解析JSON响应
        script_dict = parse_json(response)
        if script_dict is None:
            raise ValueError("无法从LLM响应中解析JSON")
        
        # 验证并创建AnimationScript对象
        animation_script = AnimationScript(**script_dict)
        
        # DSL验证
        config = get_config()
        if config.pipeline.enable_dsl_validation:
            validator = DSLValidator()
            is_valid, errors, warnings = validator.validate(animation_script)
            
            if warnings:
                for warn in warnings:
                    logger.warning(f"DSL警告: {warn}")
            
            if not is_valid:
                error_msg = "; ".join(errors)
                logger.error(f"DSL验证失败: {error_msg}")
                # 不直接失败，而是记录警告并继续
                logger.warning("忽略DSL验证错误，继续执行")
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.success(f"Animator节点完成，耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
        logger.info(f"场景名称: {animation_script.scene_name}")
        logger.info(f"序列数量: {len(animation_script.sequences)}")
        
        # 保存调试信息
        debug_info = state.get("debug_info", {})
        debug_info["animator_response"] = response
        debug_info["animator_elapsed"] = elapsed
        
        return {
            "animation_script": animation_script,
            "current_step": "coder",
            "step_history": ["animator"],
            "debug_info": debug_info,
        }
        
    except LLMClientError as e:
        logger.error(f"LLM调用失败: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"LLM调用失败: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["animator_failed"],
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Animator节点异常: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"Animator节点异常: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["animator_failed"],
        }


# =============================================================================
# Coder Node - Manim代码生成
# =============================================================================

def coder_node(state: PipelineState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Manim代码生成节点
    
    将DSL动画脚本转换为可执行的Manim Python代码。
    
    输入:
        state.animation_script: AnimationScript对象
        
    输出:
        state.manim_code: 生成的Python代码字符串
        state.current_step: 更新为 "executor"
        state.step_history: 添加 "coder"
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始执行 Coder 节点")
    logger.info("="*60)
    
    animation_script = state.get("animation_script")
    if animation_script is None:
        logger.error("animation_script为空，无法继续")
        return {
            "error_message": "动画脚本为空，请先运行Animator节点",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["coder_failed"],
        }
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # 构建prompt并调用LLM
        messages = build_coder_prompt(animation_script)
        logger.debug(f"Coder prompt消息数: {len(messages)}")
        
        client = get_llm_client()
        response = client.chat(messages)
        
        logger.debug(f"LLM响应长度: {len(response)}")
        
        # 提取Python代码
        manim_code = extract_python_code(response)
        if not manim_code:
            raise ValueError("无法从LLM响应中提取Python代码")
        
        # 基础语法检查
        try:
            compile(manim_code, "<string>", "exec")
            logger.info("代码语法检查通过")
        except SyntaxError as e:
            logger.warning(f"代码存在语法错误: {e}")
            # 记录但不立即失败，交给executor处理
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.success(f"Coder节点完成，耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
        logger.info(f"生成代码行数: {len(manim_code.splitlines())}")
        
        # 保存调试信息
        debug_info = state.get("debug_info", {})
        debug_info["coder_response"] = response
        debug_info["coder_elapsed"] = elapsed
        
        return {
            "manim_code": manim_code,
            "current_step": "executor",
            "step_history": ["coder"],
            "debug_info": debug_info,
        }
        
    except LLMClientError as e:
        logger.error(f"LLM调用失败: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"LLM调用失败: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["coder_failed"],
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Coder节点异常: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"Coder节点异常: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["coder_failed"],
        }


# =============================================================================
# Code Fixer Node - 代码修复
# =============================================================================

def code_fixer_node(state: PipelineState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    代码修复节点
    
    当代码执行失败时，根据错误信息修复代码。
    
    输入:
        state.manim_code: 当前的Python代码
        state.error_message: 执行错误信息
        state.retry_count: 当前重试次数
        
    输出:
        state.manim_code: 修复后的Python代码
        state.retry_count: 递增的重试次数
        state.current_step: 更新为 "executor"
        state.step_history: 添加 "code_fixer"
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始执行 Code Fixer 节点")
    logger.info("="*60)
    
    manim_code = state.get("manim_code", "")
    error_message = state.get("error_message", "")
    retry_count = state.get("retry_count", 0)
    
    if not manim_code:
        logger.error("没有代码可修复")
        return {
            "error_message": "没有代码可修复",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["code_fixer_failed"],
        }
    
    logger.info(f"当前重试次数: {retry_count}")
    logger.info(f"错误信息: {error_message[:200]}..." if len(error_message) > 200 else f"错误信息: {error_message}")
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # 构建修复prompt并调用LLM
        messages = build_code_fix_prompt(manim_code, error_message)
        logger.debug(f"Code Fixer prompt消息数: {len(messages)}")
        
        client = get_llm_client()
        response = client.chat(messages)
        
        logger.debug(f"LLM响应长度: {len(response)}")
        
        # 提取修复后的Python代码
        fixed_code = extract_python_code(response)
        if not fixed_code:
            raise ValueError("无法从LLM响应中提取修复后的Python代码")
        
        # 基础语法检查
        try:
            compile(fixed_code, "<string>", "exec")
            logger.info("修复后代码语法检查通过")
        except SyntaxError as e:
            logger.warning(f"修复后代码仍有语法错误: {e}")
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.success(f"Code Fixer节点完成，耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
        
        # 保存调试信息
        debug_info = state.get("debug_info", {})
        debug_info[f"code_fixer_response_{retry_count}"] = response
        debug_info[f"code_fixer_elapsed_{retry_count}"] = elapsed
        
        return {
            "manim_code": fixed_code,
            "retry_count": retry_count + 1,
            "error_message": "",  # 清除错误信息
            "current_step": "executor",
            "step_history": ["code_fixer"],
            "debug_info": debug_info,
        }
        
    except LLMClientError as e:
        logger.error(f"LLM调用失败: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"代码修复LLM调用失败: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["code_fixer_failed"],
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Code Fixer节点异常: {e}")
        return {
            "error_message": f"代码修复异常: {str(e)}",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["code_fixer_failed"],
        }


# =============================================================================
# Executor Node - 代码执行与渲染
# =============================================================================

def executor_node(state: PipelineState) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    代码执行与渲染节点
    
    执行Manim代码并生成MP4视频文件。
    
    输入:
        state.manim_code: Python代码字符串
        state.animation_script: 用于获取场景名称
        
    输出:
        state.output_file: 生成的视频文件路径
        state.success: 执行是否成功
        state.error_message: 错误信息(如果失败)
        state.step_history: 添加 "executor"
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始执行 Executor 节点")
    logger.info("="*60)
    
    manim_code = state.get("manim_code", "")
    animation_script = state.get("animation_script")
    
    if not manim_code:
        logger.error("没有代码可执行")
        return {
            "error_message": "没有代码可执行",
            "success": False,
            "step_history": ["executor_failed"],
        }
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # 延迟导入executor模块，避免循环依赖
        from text2manim.executor import ManimRenderer
        
        # 获取场景名称
        scene_name = "GeneratedScene"
        if animation_script:
            scene_name = animation_script.scene_name
        
        # 创建渲染器并执行
        renderer = ManimRenderer()
        output_file = renderer.render(manim_code, scene_name)
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.success(f"Executor节点完成，耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
        logger.info(f"输出文件: {output_file}")
        
        # 保存调试信息
        debug_info = state.get("debug_info", {})
        debug_info["executor_elapsed"] = elapsed
        
        return {
            "output_file": output_file,
            "success": True,
            "error_message": "",
            "current_step": "completed",
            "step_history": ["executor"],
            "debug_info": debug_info,
        }
        
    except Exception as e:
        error_msg = str(e)
        logger.error(f"代码执行失败: {error_msg}")
        
        # 保存调试信息
        debug_info = state.get("debug_info", {})
        debug_info["executor_error"] = error_msg
        
        return {
            "error_message": error_msg,
            "success": False,
            "current_step": "code_fixer",
            "step_history": ["executor_failed"],
            "debug_info": debug_info,
        }


# =============================================================================
# 条件路由函数
# =============================================================================

def should_fix_code(state: PipelineState) -> Literal["code_fixer", "end"]:
    """
    判断是否需要修复代码
    
    根据执行结果和重试次数决定下一步:
    - 成功: 结束
    - 失败且未超过最大重试次数: 修复代码
    - 失败且超过最大重试次数: 结束
    
    Args:
        state: 当前流水线状态
        
    Returns:
        "code_fixer" 或 "end"
    """
    success = state.get("success", False)
    retry_count = state.get("retry_count", 0)
    
    config = get_config()
    max_retries = config.pipeline.max_code_fix_attempts
    
    if success:
        logger.info("执行成功，流水线结束")
        return "end"
    
    if retry_count >= max_retries:
        logger.warning(f"已达最大重试次数({max_retries})，流水线结束")
        return "end"
    
    logger.info(f"执行失败，准备修复代码 (重试 {retry_count + 1}/{max_retries})")
    return "code_fixer"


def should_retry_execution(state: PipelineState) -> Literal["executor", "end"]:
    """
    判断是否需要重新执行
    
    代码修复后判断是否继续执行:
    - 有修复后的代码: 重新执行
    - 修复失败: 结束
    
    Args:
        state: 当前流水线状态
        
    Returns:
        "executor" 或 "end"
    """
    manim_code = state.get("manim_code", "")
    error_message = state.get("error_message", "")
    
    if manim_code and not error_message:
        logger.info("代码修复完成，重新执行")
        return "executor"
    
    logger.warning("代码修复失败，流水线结束")
    return "end"


# =============================================================================
# 辅助函数
# =============================================================================

def check_node_preconditions(state: PipelineState, required_fields: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    检查节点执行的前置条件
    
    Args:
        state: 当前流水线状态
        required_fields: 必需的字段列表
        
    Returns:
        (is_valid, error_message) 元组
    """
    for field in required_fields:
        if not state.get(field):
            return False, f"缺少必需字段: {field}"
    return True, ""


def log_state_summary(state: PipelineState, node_name: str) -> None:
    """
    记录状态摘要用于调试
    
    Args:
        state: 当前流水线状态
        node_name: 当前节点名称
    """
    logger.debug(f"[{node_name}] 状态摘要:")
    logger.debug(f"  - current_step: {state.get('current_step')}")
    logger.debug(f"  - success: {state.get('success')}")
    logger.debug(f"  - retry_count: {state.get('retry_count')}")
    logger.debug(f"  - step_history: {state.get('step_history')}")
    if state.get("error_message"):
        logger.debug(f"  - error_message: {state.get('error_message')[:100]}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
text2manim.pipeline.graph - LangGraph工作流图

定义完整的动画生成流水线工作流:
1. Planner -> Animator -> Coder -> Executor
2. 执行失败时自动进入 Code Fixer 循环

使用示例:
    from text2manim.pipeline.graph import create_pipeline, run_pipeline
    
    pipeline = create_pipeline()
    result = run_pipeline(pipeline, "勾股定理的证明")
"""

import time
import asyncio
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
from loguru import logger

from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

from text2manim.pipeline.state import (
    PipelineState,
    PipelineResult,
    create_initial_state,
    state_to_result,
)
from text2manim.pipeline.nodes import (
    planner_node,
    animator_node,
    coder_node,
    code_fixer_node,
    executor_node,
    should_fix_code,
)
from text2manim.config import get_config


# =============================================================================
# Pipeline创建函数
# =============================================================================

def create_pipeline(
    with_checkpointer: bool = False,
) -> StateGraph:
    """
    创建LangGraph流水线
    
    构建包含以下节点的状态图:
    - planner: 教学大纲规划
    - animator: DSL动画脚本设计
    - coder: Manim代码生成
    - executor: 代码执行与渲染
    - code_fixer: 代码修复(可选循环)
    
    工作流:
        START -> planner -> animator -> coder -> executor
                                                    |
                                        [失败] -> code_fixer -> executor
                                        [成功或超时] -> END
    
    Args:
        with_checkpointer: 是否启用检查点(用于断点续传)
        
    Returns:
        编译后的StateGraph对象
    """
    logger.info("创建LangGraph流水线...")
    
    # 创建状态图
    workflow = StateGraph(PipelineState)
    
    # 添加节点
    workflow.add_node("planner", planner_node)
    workflow.add_node("animator", animator_node)
    workflow.add_node("coder", coder_node)
    workflow.add_node("executor", executor_node)
    workflow.add_node("code_fixer", code_fixer_node)
    
    # 设置入口点
    workflow.set_entry_point("planner")
    
    # 添加边 - 主流程
    workflow.add_edge("planner", "animator")
    workflow.add_edge("animator", "coder")
    workflow.add_edge("coder", "executor")
    
    # 添加条件边 - 执行结果路由
    workflow.add_conditional_edges(
        "executor",
        should_fix_code,
        {
            "code_fixer": "code_fixer",
            "end": END,
        }
    )
    
    # 添加边 - 修复后重新执行
    workflow.add_edge("code_fixer", "executor")
    
    # 编译图
    if with_checkpointer:
        checkpointer = MemorySaver()
        compiled = workflow.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)
    else:
        compiled = workflow.compile()
    
    logger.success("LangGraph流水线创建完成")
    return compiled


def create_pipeline_with_skip(
    skip_to: Optional[str] = None,
) -> StateGraph:
    """
    创建支持跳过的流水线
    
    可以从指定节点开始执行，跳过前面的步骤。
    用于调试或从中间状态恢复。
    
    Args:
        skip_to: 跳过到指定节点 (planner/animator/coder/executor)
        
    Returns:
        编译后的StateGraph对象
    """
    logger.info(f"创建流水线，跳过到: {skip_to or '开始'}")
    
    workflow = StateGraph(PipelineState)
    
    # 添加所有节点
    workflow.add_node("planner", planner_node)
    workflow.add_node("animator", animator_node)
    workflow.add_node("coder", coder_node)
    workflow.add_node("executor", executor_node)
    workflow.add_node("code_fixer", code_fixer_node)
    
    # 根据skip_to设置入口点
    entry_point = skip_to or "planner"
    if entry_point not in ["planner", "animator", "coder", "executor"]:
        logger.warning(f"无效的入口点: {entry_point}，使用默认值 'planner'")
        entry_point = "planner"
    
    workflow.set_entry_point(entry_point)
    
    # 添加边
    if entry_point == "planner":
        workflow.add_edge("planner", "animator")
    if entry_point in ["planner", "animator"]:
        workflow.add_edge("animator", "coder")
    if entry_point in ["planner", "animator", "coder"]:
        workflow.add_edge("coder", "executor")
    
    # 条件边和修复循环
    workflow.add_conditional_edges(
        "executor",
        should_fix_code,
        {
            "code_fixer": "code_fixer",
            "end": END,
        }
    )
    workflow.add_edge("code_fixer", "executor")
    
    return workflow.compile()


# =============================================================================
# Pipeline执行函数
# =============================================================================

def run_pipeline(
    pipeline: StateGraph,
    user_input: str,
    initial_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> PipelineResult:
    """
    同步执行流水线
    
    Args:
        pipeline: 编译后的StateGraph对象
        user_input: 用户输入的自然语言描述
        initial_state: 可选的初始状态(用于从中间状态恢复)
        config: LangGraph运行配置
        
    Returns:
        PipelineResult对象，包含执行结果
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始执行 Text2Manim 流水线")
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info(f"用户输入: {user_input}")
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # 创建初始状态
    if initial_state:
        state = {**create_initial_state(user_input), **initial_state}
    else:
        state = create_initial_state(user_input)
    
    # 运行配置
    run_config = config or {}
    
    try:
        # 执行流水线
        final_state = pipeline.invoke(state, run_config)
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.info("="*60)
        
        # 转换为结果对象
        result = state_to_result(final_state, elapsed)
        
        if result.success:
            logger.success(f"流水线执行成功，总耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
            logger.info(f"输出文件: {result.output_file}")
        else:
            logger.error(f"流水线执行失败，总耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
            logger.error(f"错误信息: {result.error_message}")
        
        return result
        
    except Exception as e:
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.exception(f"流水线执行异常: {e}")
        
        # 创建失败结果
        return PipelineResult(
            success=False,
            error_message=f"流水线执行异常: {str(e)}",
            steps_executed=["exception"],
            total_time=elapsed,
        )


async def run_pipeline_async(
    pipeline: StateGraph,
    user_input: str,
    initial_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> PipelineResult:
    """
    异步执行流水线
    
    Args:
        pipeline: 编译后的StateGraph对象
        user_input: 用户输入的自然语言描述
        initial_state: 可选的初始状态
        config: LangGraph运行配置
        
    Returns:
        PipelineResult对象
    """
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info("开始异步执行 Text2Manim 流水线")
    logger.info("="*60)
    logger.info(f"用户输入: {user_input}")
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # 创建初始状态
    if initial_state:
        state = {**create_initial_state(user_input), **initial_state}
    else:
        state = create_initial_state(user_input)
    
    # 运行配置
    run_config = config or {}
    
    try:
        # 异步执行流水线
        final_state = await pipeline.ainvoke(state, run_config)
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        result = state_to_result(final_state, elapsed)
        
        if result.success:
            logger.success(f"异步流水线执行成功，总耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s")
        else:
            logger.error(f"异步流水线执行失败: {result.error_message}")
        
        return result
        
    except Exception as e:
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.exception(f"异步流水线执行异常: {e}")
        
        return PipelineResult(
            success=False,
            error_message=f"异步流水线执行异常: {str(e)}",
            steps_executed=["exception"],
            total_time=elapsed,
        )


def run_pipeline_stream(
    pipeline: StateGraph,
    user_input: str,
    initial_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
):
    """
    流式执行流水线，逐步返回中间状态
    
    生成器函数，每完成一个节点就yield当前状态。
    用于实时显示进度。
    
    Args:
        pipeline: 编译后的StateGraph对象
        user_input: 用户输入
        initial_state: 可选的初始状态
        config: LangGraph运行配置
        
    Yields:
        (node_name, state) 元组，表示完成的节点和当前状态
    """
    logger.info("开始流式执行 Text2Manim 流水线")
    
    # 创建初始状态
    if initial_state:
        state = {**create_initial_state(user_input), **initial_state}
    else:
        state = create_initial_state(user_input)
    
    run_config = config or {}
    
    try:
        # 流式执行
        for chunk in pipeline.stream(state, run_config):
            # chunk格式: {node_name: updated_state}
            for node_name, node_output in chunk.items():
                logger.info(f"完成节点: {node_name}")
                yield node_name, node_output
                
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"流式执行异常: {e}")
        yield "error", {"error_message": str(e), "success": False}


# =============================================================================
# 便捷函数
# =============================================================================

def generate_animation(user_input: str) -> PipelineResult:
    """
    一键生成动画的便捷函数
    
    创建流水线并执行，返回结果。
    
    Args:
        user_input: 用户输入的自然语言描述
        
    Returns:
        PipelineResult对象
        
    Example:
        result = generate_animation("勾股定理的证明")
        if result.success:
            print(f"视频已生成: {result.output_file}")
    """
    pipeline = create_pipeline()
    return run_pipeline(pipeline, user_input)


async def generate_animation_async(user_input: str) -> PipelineResult:
    """
    一键异步生成动画的便捷函数
    
    Args:
        user_input: 用户输入
        
    Returns:
        PipelineResult对象
    """
    pipeline = create_pipeline()
    return await run_pipeline_async(pipeline, user_input)


def debug_pipeline(
    user_input: str,
    stop_at: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    调试模式执行流水线
    
    可以在指定节点停止，返回完整的中间状态。
    
    Args:
        user_input: 用户输入
        stop_at: 在指定节点后停止 (planner/animator/coder/executor)
        
    Returns:
        完整的状态字典
    """
    logger.info(f"调试模式执行，停止点: {stop_at or '无'}")
    
    # 创建只包含部分节点的图
    workflow = StateGraph(PipelineState)
    
    nodes_to_include = ["planner", "animator", "coder", "executor"]
    if stop_at:
        try:
            stop_index = nodes_to_include.index(stop_at)
            nodes_to_include = nodes_to_include[:stop_index + 1]
        except ValueError:
            logger.warning(f"无效的停止点: {stop_at}")
    
    # 添加节点
    node_funcs = {
        "planner": planner_node,
        "animator": animator_node,
        "coder": coder_node,
        "executor": executor_node,
    }
    
    for node_name in nodes_to_include:
        workflow.add_node(node_name, node_funcs[node_name])
    
    # 设置入口和边
    workflow.set_entry_point(nodes_to_include[0])
    for i in range(len(nodes_to_include) - 1):
        workflow.add_edge(nodes_to_include[i], nodes_to_include[i + 1])
    workflow.add_edge(nodes_to_include[-1], END)
    
    # 编译并执行
    pipeline = workflow.compile()
    state = create_initial_state(user_input)
    
    final_state = pipeline.invoke(state)
    return dict(final_state)


# =============================================================================
# 流水线可视化
# =============================================================================

def visualize_pipeline(pipeline: StateGraph, output_path: str = "pipeline_graph.png") -> str:
    """
    可视化流水线图结构
    
    需要安装graphviz。
    
    Args:
        pipeline: 编译后的StateGraph对象
        output_path: 输出图片路径
        
    Returns:
        输出文件路径
    """
    try:
        # 获取图的Mermaid表示
        mermaid_str = pipeline.get_graph().draw_mermaid()
        logger.info(f"流水线Mermaid图:\n{mermaid_str}")
        
        # 尝试生成PNG
        try:
            png_data = pipeline.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png()
            with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(png_data)
            logger.success(f"流水线图已保存: {output_path}")
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"无法生成PNG图片: {e}")
            # 保存Mermaid文本
            mermaid_path = output_path.replace(".png", ".mmd")
            with open(mermaid_path, "w") as f:
                f.write(mermaid_str)
            logger.info(f"Mermaid文本已保存: {mermaid_path}")
            return mermaid_path
            
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"可视化失败: {e}")
        return ""
